headline: What Are the Biggest Mistakes to Avoid With a Home Addition?
articleBody:
A home addition is a major undertaking, and a few common missteps can cause big headaches. Knowing what they are ahead of time can save you from a lot of stress and unexpected costs.

One of the biggest mistakes is not doing your due diligence on zoning rules and permits *before* you start designing. Imagine creating the perfect plan, only to find out it violates local setback or height restrictions. Always check regulations first. Another major error is failing to create a realistic budget that includes a 10-20% contingency fund for surprises. Without it, an unexpected issue can bring your project to a halt. Finally, don’t hire a contractor based on the lowest bid alone. Poor quality work, code violations, and legal issues are far more expensive in the long run. Make sure your contractor is licensed, insured, and has a strong reputation for this type of work.
